title: The three Happys and Ramis Matthews
summary: There were three men called Happy, including a red-skinned one and a brother of Bill Matthews; Ramis Matthews was called Happy and died recently. Bill Matthews was a good drummer.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Say, I wanted to ask you, how many Happys were there?
There were two Happys. There were three Happys. Three Happys, huh?
Mm-hm. Because Happy was a red boy. And so they ate the change and said, who you talking about, black Happy or red?
Was Red older or younger than you?
Oh, he was just around my age.
And who was the third one?
And they called him what? Happy. Just Happy.
And which one? There was a Bebe and a Ramis Matthews.
Ramis is the one they used to call Happy.
He just died a couple months ago.
Yeah, a couple months ago he just died.
Bill Matthews used to play drums too, didn't he?
Yeah, he was a drummer. He was a good drummer. He was a good drummer. Which all them masters were good drummers.
